about: The player hairstyles and facial hair made by tools/iconforge/hair.py: kind, file name, the existing style shown as the starting point, and the description. Rebuild one with: python tools/iconforge/hair.py <kind> <name> --ref <ref> --describe "<description>" (cached; --force asks the model again).
